procedure.method: Fresh independent craft review in this session; no spawning, resuming, forking or peer review access. Read the literal packet/case, pinned rules/rubric/addendum/method and ratio policy. Verified listed byte/hash pins and PNG headers and read all five listed native-evidence manifests without following their embedded paths. The packet has no supplied source assets or protected-layout manifests, so both source receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Then used tools.view_image with detail original and emitted each returned image for actual visual inspection: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320, in five sequential functions.exec calls with three sequential opens each. All 15 exact images were seen before the first copy-reading/transcription stage, any judgment or any score. After the complete viewing sequence, read each Title and then body from the retained visible native/use images in packet order. No ambiguous glyph or punctuation required a revisit; no additional poster opens, crops, substitutions, image creation or editing. Usage views are 720x405 for M1/M2 and 720x1080 for M3/M4/M5; thumbnails are 320x180 and 213x320 respectively. These are actual viewing attestations, not helper-exit or filename inferences. Session ID is unobservable here and remains null.
